title: system.control.update_config Output
description: Output schema for the system.control.update_config module. Sensitive values MUST be redacted as '***' in the return body.

key.description: Dot-path of the updated configuration key.

old_value.description: Previous value. Redacted as '***' when the key matches a sensitive pattern (token, secret, key, password, auth, credential).

new_value.description: New value. Redacted as '***' when the key matches a sensitive pattern (token, secret, key, password, auth, credential).
